topic: Bulk-buying staples vs daily convenience runs (Royce vs Marlowe)

scenes.narration: Daily corner store runs cost him eighteen hundred more than her bulk hauls. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a giant bulk pack of staples, comic burst banner reads EIGHTEEN HUNDRED MORE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Royce and Marlowe both use the same household staples weekly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man royce and woman marlowe each holding identical staples, paper towels and rice, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Paper towels, coffee, rice, soap, the everyday basics.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a row of staple items labeled PAPER TOWELS, COFFEE, RICE, SOAP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Royce grabs them one at a time at the corner store.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, royce at a tiny corner store grabbing a single item, a sign reading CONVENIENCE PRICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays the highest unit price every single trip.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, royce holding one item with a price tag stamped HIGHEST UNIT PRICE, comic banner reads PREMIUM, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marlowe buys staples in bulk once a month at warehouse prices.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marlowe pushing a loaded warehouse cart full of bulk packs, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She compares unit price and buys only staples that store well.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marlowe holding two packs comparing tags labeled UNIT PRICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One monthly trip stocks her whole pantry shelf.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marlowe loading a full pantry shelf with neatly stacked bulk staples, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One year later Royce made over three hundred tiny pricey trips.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, tired royce surrounded by a pile of small receipts, a counter reading THREE HUNDRED TRIPS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Marlowe spent eighteen hundred dollars less on the exact same goods.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marlowe smiling beside a savings jar reading EIGHTEEN HUNDRED SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She also saved hours by skipping all those little runs.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, marlowe relaxing beside a clock stamped HOURS SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bulk buy staples by unit price, skip convenience runs. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
